items.title: Since the 1950s, Boston & Philly's NBA franchises have engaged in playoff combat every decade but the '90s.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Since the 1950s, Boston & Philly's NBA franchises have engaged in playoff combat every decade but the '90s.

That includes squaring off 4 times in the last 9 years.

History suggests they'll see each other again, with elevated stakes. For Tatum, it's an incredible opportunity for his legacy.
